challenge.method: Compared the complete COPYRIGHT grant, numbered conditions 0 through 5, and final disclaimer with both pinned SPDX texts. Tested ordered case-folded alphanumeric tokens, punctuation, whitespace-normalized equality, and byte equality. Removed clause 4 as a near-match control and checked the tag against both exact SPDX URLs.
challenge.results: Both SPDX representations match all 335 tokens in order and are byte-identical to each other. The publisher capture differs by one trailing space in clause 4. Removing clause 4 leaves 281 tokens and fails both comparisons. The JSON commentary identifies the missing advertising clause as the distinction from Inner-Net-2.0. Both exact SPDX URLs use the tag target.

limitations: The result covers the pinned COPYRIGHT capture. The mutable master cross-reference, other project versions, and the status of any version subject to condition 0 remain unverified.
The Inner-Net-2.0 challenge used the fixed detail record's metadata and a clause-deletion control. An Inner-Net-2.0 original was outside the named evidence set.
Legal equivalence, rights for other works, text reuse, installation, and Index lifecycle are outside scope.
The release tag is unsigned. The supplied SCES commit and bundle digest were not independently verified from bundle bytes.
